s.t:
Bei dir sind unsere Kunden in besten Händen.
Wir sind eine B2B-Marketing- und Sales-Beratung, die ihren Kunden dabei hilft, strategische Ausrichtungen zu entwickeln, Sichtbarkeit zu erhöhen, Neukunden zu gewinnen und Sales-Prozesse zu implementieren.
Wir sind ein junges Team, arbeiten schnell und klar – und wollen wachsen.
Und genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden, der richtig Lust auf Verantwortung, Kundenführung und persönliche Entwicklung hat.
Klingt gut? Top – dann hätten wir da was für dich!
Aufgaben
1. Strategische Beratung & Kundenführung
Kunden charmant & souverän beraten
LinkedIn-Strategien klar vermitteln
Sicherheit geben, Humor reinbringen, Beziehung aufbauen
Mit Klarheit führen, um „Wünsch-dir-was“-Chaos zu vermeiden
2. Projektkoordination & Qualitätssicherung
Schnelle, zuverlässige & professionelle Kundenkommunikation
Betreuung von ca. 30 parallelen Kundenaccounts
Ergebnisse und Feedback klar an alle Stakeholder kommunizieren
Reportings vorbereiten und überzeugend präsentieren
3. Ergebnisse verkaufen & Upsell platzieren
Erfolge emotional aufladen und Kunden für die Entwicklung begeistern
Upsell Potenziale identifizieren („Das wäre jetzt sinnvoll für dich…“)
Weitere Offerings charmant und beratend platzieren
Qualifikation
Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten: Du kannst Menschen abholen, verstehen und durch Gespräche führen.
Standing & Klarheit in der Beratung: Du kannst freundlich, aber bestimmt sagen, was sinnvoll ist – und was nicht.
Fachliche Erfahrung: Idealerweise hast du ein Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang abgeschlossen.
Struktur & Verlässlichkeit: Du organisierst ca. 30 Kunden ruhig, sauber und ohne Chaos.
Business-Verständnis oder Interesse daran: Du kannst dich in Geschäftsmodelle hineindenken und Kundenstrategien verstehen.
Affinität zu digitalen Tools und KI: CRM, LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Outreach Automation, ChatGPT
Lernbereitschaft & Ambition: Du willst wachsen, Verantwortung übernehmen und besser werden.

Ein Job, der dich persönlich wachsen lässt
Du wirst extrem gut im Kommunizieren
Du lernst LinkedIn durch und durch kennen
Du lernst, wie man Menschen führt
Du verstehst, wie B2B-Geschäftsmodelle funktionieren

✔️ flexible Arbeitszeiten
✔️ fancy Büro in Mainz oder Homeoffice
✔️ junges dynamisches Team (22-32 Jahre) aus High-Performern, die dich bei der Umsetzung deiner Ideen unterstützen
✔️ 1on1 Mentoring, um deine Skills entsprechend deiner Karrierewünsche auszubauen
✔️ Worcation, coole Teamevents und Top Unternehmenskultur (überzeug dich selbst: https://youtu.be/6rXz6Z51i44 )
Wenn du Verantwortung willst, Menschen magst und gerne führst statt verwaltest, dann ist diese Rolle für dich.
Du wirst schnell wachsen, viel lernen und echten Einfluss haben. Bewirb dich, wenn du bereit bist, mit einem geilen Team richtig durchzustarten.

Dein Einstieg in High-Performance-Sales
Du willst nach dem Studium nicht Folien bauen, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen? Bei Justhome begleitest du Menschen bei der größten finanziellen Entscheidung ihres Lebens – dem Immobilienkauf. Du arbeitest mit KI-Tools, die dir 70 % der Administration abnehmen, bekommst exklusive, kaufbereite Anfragen statt Kaltakquise und verdienst ab Tag 1 mit an deinem Erfolg.
Wir sind ein kapitalgestütztes Wachstumsunternehmen im Herzen Berlins und digitalisieren die Baufinanzierung – einen Markt, der technologisch Jahre hinterherhinkt. Genau deshalb suchen wir keine klassischen Banker, sondern analytisch starke Absolvent:innen, die schnell lernen und gern verkaufen.
Aufgaben
Beraten & Abschließen: Du verwandelst qualifizierte Kundenanfragen in passgenaue Finanzierungslösungen – im Gespräch per Video und Telefon, ohne Kaltakquise.
Tech statt Tippen: Unsere KI-gestützten Tools strukturieren Daten, formulieren E-Mails vor und bereiten die Einreichung bei über 700 Bankpartnern vor. Du konzentrierst dich auf den Kunden.
Netzwerk nutzen: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren 170+ Partner-Maklerunternehmen zusammen – die technische Integration liefert dir Objektunterlagen oft, bevor du das erste Telefonat führst.
Produkt mitgestalten: Du gibst direktes Feedback an unser Tech-Team und prägst so mit, wie unsere Tools von morgen aussehen.
Qualifikation
Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (z.B. BWL, VWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften – auch dual) oder eine Bankausbildung
Analytische Stärke, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Empathie, Menschen bei ihrer wichtigsten finanziellen Entscheidung sicher zu begleiten
Hunger, in Rekordzeit zum Finanzierungsexperten aufzusteigen – Vorkenntnisse in Baufinanzierung brauchst du nicht
Wichtig zu wissen: Für den Start brauchst du die Sachkundeprüfung nach §34i GewO – nicht aber für deine Bewerbung. Wir geben dir eine Zusage vorab. Wenn du bei uns einsteigst, erstatten wir dir die Prüfungs- und Vorbereitungskosten im Umfang von bis zu 1.000 €.

Attraktives Gehaltspaket: €60.000 Zielgehalt im ersten Jahr (Fixum + ungedeckelte Provision). Bei sehr guter Leistung sind im zweiten Jahr €70.000–90.000 realistisch - und auch das ist nicht die Obergrenze.
Echte Aufstiegsperspektive: Führungsverantwortung als Teamleiter:in in zwei Jahren ist bei uns ein realer Karrierepfad, weil wir kontinuierlich wachsen.
Hybrid arbeiten: Nach der Probezeit 3 Tage im Loft-Büro am Rosenthaler Platz, 2 Tage Home Office.
Beste Ausstattung: Dein Mitarbeiter-Laptop und unsere starke CRM-Technologie unterstützen dich im Arbeitsalltag
Team, das zusammenhält: Wir feiern Erfolge gemeinsam – zuletzt mit dem ganzen Team beim Bootfahren und Grillen auf der Havel.
So einfach bewirbst du dich
Kein Anschreiben nötig. Schick uns deinen CV oder einfach dein LinkedIn-/Xing-Profil – wir melden uns innerhalb von 48 Stunden zurück.
Wir besetzen zwei Positionen mit frühestmöglichem Start. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Partner with CSMs to develop account plans that map customer goals to rePurpose capabilities and surface expansion opportunities
Manage expansion deal cycles from identification through close, coordinating with Sales where appropriate
Forecast pipeline accurately and maintain clean account data in HubSpot
Customer relationships
Serve as a primary commercial point of contact for your portfolio, building trust across multiple stakeholder levels
Conduct regular business reviews that connect customer outcomes to the value rePurpose delivers
Anticipate customer needs and bring solutions proactively — before issues become escalations
Playbook and process building
Help define and build the AM function from the ground up — this is a new motion and you will have direct influence over how it operates
Develop and iterate on account planning frameworks, renewal playbooks, and expansion triggers in partnership with CS leadership
Surface patterns across your portfolio to inform team-wide process improvements
Cross-functional partnership
Work inside a CS pod with CSMs, sharing account context, aligning on customer health, and coordinating on timing for commercial conversations
Bring structured product feedback to Product and Engineering — synthesized across accounts, not escalated one at a time
Collaborate with Sales on handoffs, expansion deal support, and pipeline coordination

A Day-in-a-Life of our Business Development ManagerÂ
As a Business Development Manager at EatClub, you will spend most of your time out in the market, meeting venue owners, building relationships, and growing the platform one partnership at a time.
Your territory is yours to build. You'll be walking into restaurants, calling operators, and scheduling meetings with the venues you believe will thrive on the platform. Some days start with mapping the neighbourhoods you want to focus on, identifying the venues that fit the product best, and planning how you'll approach them.
Most of your day is spent face-to-face with restaurant owners and managers. You're introducing EatClub, explaining how the platform works, and helping operators see how it can drive more customers through their doors.

Conversations move quickly - some venues sign up after one conversation, others take a few follow-ups - but momentum matters and your pipeline moves fast. Average time from first walk-in to signed agreement is under two weeks. You are not waiting on approval chains - you close and move on to the next one.
Between meetings, you're updating your pipeline, following up with prospects, and preparing for the next round of conversations.
You'll also work closely with the broader EatClub team, sharing insights about the local hospitality market, feeding back what venue owners are saying, and helping refine how we approach new cities as we expand across the AU.
This role suits someone who thrives working independently, does not need a manager to tell them what to do next, and gets genuine satisfaction from seeing a number on a board they built themselves.

Supporting new city launches. As we continue to grow, you will have a chance to be part of the team that kicks off new cities.

Republic Services , Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.
In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.
Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.
Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.

s.h: Our company values guide our daily actions

Safe : We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
Committed to Serve : We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
Driven : We deliver results in the right way.
Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.
We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.

Republic Services ’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.
We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.
With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.
Recycling and Waste
We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.
Environmental Solutions
Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

In unserem Bereich gehören wir zu den grösseren Playern und sind bekannt für unsere hohe Qualität. Kein Wunder, werden wir immer wieder als herausragend guter Umsetzungspartner ausgezeichnet.

Nous transformons la façon dont le monde mange et fait ses courses en rendant leur accès plus pratique et agréable. Nous connectons les consommateurs, les restaurants, les magasins et les cyclistes. Nous sommes une entreprise axée sur la technologie, à l'avant-garde d’un secteur qui connaît une des expansions les plus rapides au monde. Nous avançons rapidement, valorisons l'autonomie, et sommes toujours en recherche de nouvelles idées et de personnes talentueuses pour nous rejoindre!

Environnement de travail & avantages
Chez Deliveroo, nous savons que les employés sont au cœur de l'entreprise et nous accordons une grande importance à leur bien-être.

Les avantages varient d'un pays à l'autre, mais nous proposons du télétravail hybride, ainsi que de nombreux avantages dans des domaines tels que la santé, le bien-être, les congés parentaux, la retraite ainsi que des congés pour soutenir une œuvre de bienfaisance de votre choix. Les avantages sont propres à chaque pays.

Pour plus d'informations, veuillez vous adresser à la personne chargée du recrutement pour ce poste.
Diversité
Nous sommes convaincus qu'un excellent environnement de travail est celui qui reflète le monde dans lequel nous vivons dans toute sa diversité. Nous ne portons aucun jugement sur ce qui fait de vous la personne que vous êtes - que ce soit votre genre, votre race, votre sexualité, votre religion ou même une aversion secrète pour la coriandre!
Deliveroo France a obtenu un score de 98/100 à l'Indice de l'Égalité Hommes-Femmes 2024, témoignage de notre engagement envers la diversité et l'égalité des chances. Ce dont vous avez besoin pour nous rejoindre, c'est surtout le désir de faire partie de l'une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide dans un secteur passionnant, celui de la foodtech.
À compétences égales, ce poste est ouvert aux travailleurs et travailleuses en situation de handicap ou assimilés au sens de l’article L5212-13 du Code du travail. Deliveroo s’engage en faveur de la diversité, l’égalité professionnelle, l’emploi des personnes en situation de handicap.

s.h: THIS IS A REAL STEP INTO CLOSING
s.t:
You booked the meeting. Someone else closed it. Not here.
Your number. Your accounts. Your calls. Your deals. Start to finish.
You already know this feeling
You worked the account for weeks. You found the pain, you got the right person on the phone, you booked the meeting. Then you handed it over and watched someone else take it to signature and pick up the commission.
This is the seat where you keep it.

You own a UK and Ireland mid-market patch and carry a monthly new-business ARR target. You find every opportunity yourself, and you close it yourself. There is no SDR underneath you and nobody filling your diary. We give you the data, the tools, the coaching and a few live opportunities to get you moving. Everything after that is yours to build.
If that reads as a warning, this is not your role. If it reads as an opportunity, keep going.
What you’ll actually be doing
Picking your target accounts and going after them properly
Cold calling. Every week. It does not stop being part of the job when you start closing
Running discovery that reaches business impact, not a feature checklist
Demoing Joblogic to operations directors, finance and business owners
Multi-threading, building the commercial case, negotiating and closing
Keeping HubSpot honest and forecasting a number you are happy to be held to
What we’ll give you
A structured 90-day ramp into discovery, demonstrations, commercials and closing. You will never be guessing what good looks like
Full coaching as standard: MEDDPICC is our qualification standard and we will teach it to you, alongside discovery, demo and negotiation training, weekly call reviews and deal clinics
Live opportunities at the start to get you selling while you build your own engine
The data, tooling and tech stack to prospect properly, so your time goes on selling rather than list building
A real career, with a fast-growing, PE-backed software business scaling to £100M ARR. This is the first seat of a career here, not the last
You’ll love this if
You have 12-36 months as an SDR or BDR and you have smashed your number, and you can prove it with real figures
A cold call that turns into a deal is still the best part of your week
You are competitive with yourself before you are competitive with anyone else
You want feedback, not comfort, and you act on it fast
You want to be judged on ARR, not on dials and diary entries
You are curious about how businesses actually make money, not just about hitting activity targets

You want your pipeline handed to you.
You think prospecting stops the day you start closing.
Your best answer to “how did you perform?” is “the team hit target”.
Joblogic in thirty seconds
We are the UK’s #1 Field Service Management software platform. Founded in 1998, ~£35M ARR, 500+ people and over 100,000 users across HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management and building fabric maintenance. We are backed by Vista Equity Partners with over £100 million of new capital behind us, and we are scaling to £100M ARR with an AI-first product roadmap.
Put simply: the market is huge, the product wins, and the ceiling on this team has just been lifted. We need people who want to run at that.

Send us your CV, and tell us in a few lines about the best opportunity you have ever self-sourced (In the Cover Letter). How you found it, how you got in, what happened next. We are far more interested in that than in how your CV is formatted.
Bring energy. This team runs on it.

About Semarchy Semarchy helps enterprises master, govern, and put their data to work through a unified Data Platform spanning Master Data Management, data quality, and data governance, deployable natively inside Snowflake or as SaaS. Our customers use Semarchy to bring order to data spread across dozens of systems and turn it into something they can trust for reporting, operations, and AI.
The RoleWe're hiring an Account Executive for our AMER Enterprise team. You'll own a full-cycle book of business, from qualifying inbound and self-sourced pipeline through discovery, solution development, demo, negotiation, and close. Our deals are consultative and multi-stakeholder: you're rarely selling to one person, and the technical conversation is usually a proxy for a business one underneath it.
Ownership doesn't end at signature. You'll build the account plan, hand off cleanly to Professional Services and Customer Success, and come back in to lead the commercial conversation when it's time to expand, renew, or move an existing customer onto our newly upgraded platform. Responsibilities

Build pipeline. Generate and qualify opportunities through inbound requests, closed-lost revisits, referrals, and your own outbound. Keep Salesforce and Gong current as deals move, not just at quarter-end, so your forecast holds up two months out.
Run discovery that gets past the ticket. Uncover the prospect's high-level company goals, bring company and industry context into the call, and get past the technical and personal pain to the real organizational stakes: what happens if nothing changes, and why that matters to the business.
Multi-thread the deal. Identify who else needs to be in the room and bring them in deliberately, rather than waiting for the prospect to volunteer them.
Shape the solution. Understand what the prospect thinks they need, and know when to introduce a requirement they haven't asked for yet, whether that's a related module or the specific reason we're the better fit against the alternative they're evaluating.
Partner with your SC on a demo that sells the pain, not the feature. Own the value narrative and coordinate the technical demo with your Solutions Consultant, who leads it. Tie what's shown back to what the prospect named in discovery, and give your SC the lead time they need to prep, especially when a demo gets booked with less than a day's notice.
Negotiate a real plan. Know which agreement you need next given where the deal actually is, and leave every call with a specific next step, a date, and a named owner on both sides.
Build a business case your champion can carry into their own organization, tied to the financial and operational impact you uncovered together.
Manage the process to close, tracking the paper, security review, and approvals that sit between a verbal yes and a signature.
Own the account plan and the handoff. Build the plan for your named accounts, lead a clean handoff to Professional Services and Customer Success at close, and stay the commercial owner for expansion, renewal, and platform-transition conversations in your book.

A track record closing complex, multi-stakeholder software deals, ideally in data, analytics, or platform categories.
Comfort running a structured sales process while staying present and conversational. The framework should make the conversation feel more natural, not scripted.
Directness balanced with warmth. You can name a stalled buy-in or an unrealistic timeline out loud, in a way that keeps the relationship intact.
Genuine curiosity about the prospect's business, not just their tech stack. You ask a second and third “why,” and you're comfortable letting a call go somewhere your outline didn't predict.
Coachability. You take feedback, apply it, and can name your own gaps before someone else does.
A collaborative style, especially with your SC. You don't need deep technical fluency on day one; you need the instinct to loop your SC in early and work the deal together, not around them. You also bring in deal desk, partners, and leadership early.
Ownership. You flag a deal risk before it becomes a surprise, and you show up with a plan alongside it.
Judgment about where your time goes. With a growing book, you know which two or three accounts genuinely need you this week and protect the rest of your time for the next deal.

Experience selling into Snowflake or Databricks ecosystems.
Familiarity with MDM, data governance, or data quality, or the track record to get there fast.
Experience competing against vendors like Informatica or Reltio.

We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success.

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Intro This is a role for someone who wants to own something real, not just execute on someone else's vision.
At Carbmee, we're building the environmental intelligence platform that the world's largest industrial companies use to measure, manage, and reduce their carbon emissions. We work with companies like Maersk, Lufthansa, and Zeiss. And we're growing fast!
As (Senior) Key Account Manager , you'll own and grow our automotive customer base. You'll have real responsibility from day one, and what you build here will actually matter.
You'll spend the majority of your time deepening relationships with existing enterprise accounts (expansion, additional use cases, renewals) while also opening a smaller number of new strategic accounts in the automotive and industrial supplier space.
You'll work directly with our CEO and sales leadership to build the account strategy from the ground up.
Your tasks Own a portfolio of existing automotive enterprise accounts , driving expansion and deepening carbmee's footprint.
Identify, develop and close new strategic accounts in automotive and adjacent supplier industries.
Build multi-threaded relationships across sustainability, procurement, and operations stakeholders at large automotive OEMs and Tier 1/2 suppliers.
Translate carbmee's carbon accounting and environmental intelligence platform into concrete value for automotive-specific challenges (CBAM, Scope 3, supply chain decarbonization)
Run a consultative, value-based sales process (MEDDIC or SPICED) rather than a feature-led pitch
Partner closely with our Field Deployment Engineers team to ensure accounts are set up to renew and expand
Be a thought partner on how outcome-based and AI-driven selling motions layer on top of traditional SaaS sales
Your profile 3+ years in enterprise SaaS sales or key account management , with a strong trajectory (quota overachievement, fast progression) weighted more heavily than years alone
Experience selling into automotive OEMs or Tier 1/2 suppliers, and fluency in the transformation challenges the industry is facing
Background from a PLM, enterprise software, or value-based SaaS environment, ideally with automotive or industrial manufacturing exposure
Prior startup or high-growth company experience: you know what it's like to build process, not just execute it
Proven quota attainment and a track record of growing existing accounts , not just closing new ones
Fluent German and English
Based in or willing to relocate to Munich: this role requires in-person presence (3 days x week) with the team and close collaboration with customer-facing colleagues.
Benefits Unique & Powerful Mission: join a fast-growing and ambitious tech company that is shaping the future of carbon management and fighting climate change
Compensation & Rewards: a steep learning curve and ownership from day one. We offer an attractive compensation package, including virtual stock options
Health & Wellbeing: Urban Sports Club subscription to stay healthy & fit.1:1 coaching sessions with Nilohealth for your mental well-being.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: a flexible hybrid working culture with a lovely accessible office in Berlin-Mitte or the center of Munich
Team Culture: Our transparency, Humility, and Accountability values create a unique and supportive working environment. Be part of a multinational, motivated team that thinks work should be fun!
Connection & Networking: Summer Offsite, Winter Party, and regular team events We give you plenty of opportunities to connect with people, strengthen cross-functional relationships, and boost collaboration
Trust & Transparency: monthly All-Hands Meetings, weekly update newsletters, and Founders Q&As. We keep you informed on current company numbers and goals

C-4 Analytics is a fast-growing, private, full-service digital marketing company that excels at helping automotive dealerships increase sales, increase market share, and lower cost per acquisition.

C-4 Analytics is committed to developing innovative solutions for every dealer in every market, and to providing the highest levels of accountability and customer service. We are currently hiring for a Digital Marketing Account Manager: REMOTE as we look to expand our team and support our growing roster of local and national clients.
If you are unable to complete this application due to a disability, contact this employer to ask for accommodation or an alternative application process.

s.h: Who We're Looking For: Digital Marketing Account Manager: REMOTE
s.t:
We’re looking for a high-impact, client-facing Account Manager to serve as the dedicated advocate and primary point of contact for a portfolio of C-4 Analytics ' key clients.

This isn’t a passive coordination role; it’s a proactive, holistic management position where you take full ownership of translating complex business objectives into winning digital marketing programs.

You’ll be expected to master our core services and articulate their value with authority, acting as the strategic bridge between client goals and technical execution.
You’ll operate at the center of the action, driving comprehensive strategies and managing high-stakes campaign tasks across every internal department—from Paid Search and Creative to Content, Local, and Social Media. This role requires a "do-the-work" mentality to ensure every moving part is synchronized and every campaign is delivered with precision. If you’re a natural relationship-builder who thrives on connecting the dots between client vision and digital performance, you’ll do well here.
A day in the life of a Digital Marketing Account Manager: REMOTE
Portfolio & Relationship Management: Serve as the primary advocate and day-to-day contact for a portfolio of 12+ "rooftops," proactively managing client satisfaction and performance to ensure maximum retention.
Strategic Execution & Optimization: Own the full campaign lifecycle—from initial strategy and pitch to setup and execution—across Paid Search, Social, and Web, while conducting regular platform checks to ensure optimal performance.
Data Analysis & Reporting: Utilize Google Analytics and Google Ads to analyze traffic, pitch optimizations, and deliver comprehensive monthly reports that translate complex data into compelling narratives.
Cross-Functional & Third-Party Coordination: Lead internal teams (Creative, Content, Paid Search) and external vendors to ensure timely implementation of strategies and rigorous task tracking within JIRA.
Communication & Presentation: Lead weekly client update meetings and maintain professional, timely communication to keep stakeholders informed on progress and campaign health.
Compliance & Quality Control: Ensure all marketing assets meet brand standards, maintain regulatory compliance, and receive formal client approval prior to launch.
Operational Agility: Handle additional duties as assigned and travel as necessary to support client needs and business objectives.

Must-Haves
3 plus years of Digital Marketing, Account Management or direct Client-Facing experience
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, a related degree or equivalent relevant industry experience
All different levels of technical digital acumen are welcome (and encouraged!) to apply
Strong presentation skills –ability to demonstrate value to clients and serve as a trusted digital advisor
Excellent written and verbal communication skills – ability to write professional emails to clients and third parties
Demonstrated time management and project management skills
A positive attitude that resonates throughout your team and the company
Demonstrated familiarity with Google products (Gmail, Docs, Slides, Drive) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) products
Nice-To-Haves
2-plus years' experience building multi-faceted digital marketing campaigns, including SEO, SEM, PPC, Social and email marketing services
Google Analytics & Ads Certifications
Experience using a project management tool, preferably JIRA
Experience working with or in the automotive industry

Compensation: We offer a competitive compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications. The salary range for this position is $60,000.00 - $75,000.00.The final salary will be determined based on factors such as skills, knowledge, and demonstrated expertise.
Please note that the stated salary range is flexible and negotiable based on individual qualifications and fit for the role. We encourage candidates to discuss their salary expectations during the interview process.
Working at C-4 Analytics
We provide our employees with a range of benefits, including career development programs, unlimited paid time off, and additional perks. All are welcome to visit ourcareers andculture page for more details.

Want to know what makes working at C-4 Analytics so rewarding? Take it from the true experts: our current teammates. Recent surveys about our workplace and culture suggest that our staff loves:
The People: It's not just a cliché; we have the best, hungriest and smartest team in the business.
The Culture: Teamwork. Camaraderie. Perseverance. We hire for these traits, and it shows.
The Growth: We place a real emphasis on training, development and career planning.
The Trust: Our managers empower their people and teams to thrive in their own ways.
The Challenge: We work in a competitive industry and a dynamic field. You'll never be bored!
More About C-4 Analytics
C-4 Analytics takes the guesswork out of advertising. We don’t over-promise: we over-deliver. We provide real value to our clients because we really value them as partners. We love Google and Facebook, but also love Instagram and Bing. We innovate, educate and instigate. We are forward-thinking, but we learn from the past.

We are results-driven and our strategies drive results. We love the practical applications of psychology to marketing, but we aren’t above a good practical joke. We are team players, but we love to crush our competitors. We create an environment of respect and we respect the environment. We are the brains and the good looks. We are very humble.

We are nerds, but cool, likable nerds. We are never gonna give you up. Never gonna let you down. We are all work and all play. We calculated that only 15.8% of visitors who started this paragraph would actually read this far down. We are C-4 Analytics .

After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving upmarket, and this is one of the key sales roles that proves the commercial motion as we pursue increasingly complex retail accounts.

As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not fully exist at Toast Retail yet. You will help build it, one deal at a time.
This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a finished playbook. Some proof points exist from our SMB business, leadership is investing, and there is a set of open questions that closers in the field have to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner?

Which SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form hypotheses, test them in live deals, and feed what works back so the next AEs can run it.
You will report to the Manager, Mid Market Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations of 30% or more, including store walks and on site visits.

Pipeline and prospecting: Build a qualified pipeline of multi-location grocery, liquor, and convenience operators through category research, cold calling, networking, and close partnership with our SMB Retail teams to identify accounts ready to move upmarket.
Retail centric discovery: Run disciplined discovery against buying committees rather than single owners. Learn the operational realities that move a category buyer, from inventory depth and scan data to shrink, margin, and compliance, and turn them into a compelling case for Toast Retail.
Value based selling: Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast Retail value proposition through demonstrations and tailored business cases. Sell on platform value and outcomes over price, and help operators understand which products actually fit their scale.
Full lifecycle ownership: Own the entire journey, from lead development and financial structuring to contract negotiation and close. Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation to ensure a seamless handoff on retail installs that are meaningfully harder than a single site.
Complex deal navigation: Manage lengthy sales cycles with real ambiguity. Multithread across operations, finance, IT, and merchandising, and develop champions inside layered retail organizations.
Internal collaboration: Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Biz Ops, and Finance to structure deals, and hold your ground in negotiations so terms align with Toast 's goals. Work with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close the gaps between us and a repeatable Mid Market Retail motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself.
Build as you close: Convert what works in your live deals into discovery notes, demo flows, and business case models the next AEs can run. Distinguish a repeatable process from a one off hero deal, and help codify the former.
Voice of the retailer: Bring the Mid Market retailer's needs back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes.
Revenue mindset: Optimize for long term realized revenue, not just bookings. Evaluate the full financial impact of every deal, ask what it will actually cost us, and make thoughtful trade offs on pricing, discounts, and terms while protecting Toast 's bottom line.
Operational excellence: Maintain high standards of execution, prioritization, and follow through in Salesforce and the broader GTM tech stack, and help establish the conversion benchmarks that do not exist yet.

5+ years of successful technology or professional services sales experience, ideally within SaaS, payments, or retail or restaurant industry technology.
A track record sourcing and closing complex, multi-stakeholder deals, ideally multi-location or upmarket.
Proven skills in complex deal development, financial structuring, negotiation, and closing with both new and existing customers, with a focus on selling on value rather than deep discounting.
Proficiency with MEDDPICC or a comparable qualification methodology, plus disciplined pipeline management and forecasting.
A builder's instinct. You are energized rather than frustrated by ambiguity, and when a process is missing your instinct is to write it rather than wait for it.
Exceptional customer engagement and active listening. You do not just pitch, you solve problems for operators.
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to hold the room with executive stakeholders.
Comfort educating customers on the fundamentals of US credit card processing, including surcharging and processing nuances.
Strong organizational skills and a disciplined, process driven approach to selling, reporting, and tracking.
Ability to travel 30% or more.
What will help you stand out
Experience selling into or operating within grocery, convenience, liquor, or specialty retail.
Fluency in the operational realities of retail: inventory depth and SKU management, scan data, shrink, category management, age verification and compliance, fuel and foodservice.
Experience selling into franchised organizations, navigating both franchisor and franchisee requirements, buying processes, and stakeholder management
Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to complete complex RFPs, bonus if you’ve helped write a RFP for a prospect just starting their evaluation process
Experience helping stand up a new segment, vertical, or motion inside an existing company, especially taking an SMB product upmarket.
Experience in a fast paced, high growth technology environment.
AI at Toast
At Toast , one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality.

We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toast ers are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it's a core part of our culture.
Our Total Rewards Philosophy
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toast ers' changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at.
The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

This role is for an experienced and highly motivated SaaS Sales professional specializing in payments solutions. The Payments Sales Representative will be responsible for driving revenue growth by selling into and expanding existing accounts within our client base. You will promote and sell SaaS-based payments solutions specifically designed for aesthetic medical practices and salons, helping practitioners maximize revenue while simplifying their operations.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform the following satisfactorily; other duties may be assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Lead Sales Efforts
Promote and sell SaaS-based payments solutions to existing client base, identifying expansion opportunities within current accounts and driving adoption of payments services.
Generate and Nurture Leads
Identify and pursue new client opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and leveraging company programs to build a robust pipeline.
Understand Customer Needs
Conduct in-depth discovery conversations with clients and prospects to identify their specific payments challenges, needs, and goals. Analyze their business models to uncover opportunities for payments optimization.
Deliver Compelling Value Propositions
Effectively communicate the benefits and value proposition of PatientNow 's payments platform, highlighting its ability to boost revenue, seamlessly integrate with PatientNow 's core EMR/PM software, and offer competitive rates. Compare clients' current payment processing costs with our solutions to demonstrate clear savings and competitive advantages.
Analyze Merchant Statements
Review merchant statements to identify all associated fees and costs. Demonstrate expertise in understanding different pricing structures (e.g., interchange plus, tiered pricing) and recognizing hidden fees or inflated rates that clients could eliminate by switching to PatientNow 's payment solutions.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally
Work closely with sales, support, onboarding, product, marketing, customer success, and other internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction, support smooth implementation, and drive continuous improvements.
Achieve Sales Targets
Consistently meet and exceed assigned sales quotas and KPIs, demonstrating accountability and results-driven performance.
CRM and Sales Tool Expertise
Proficiently use CRM systems like Salesforce to track sales activities, maintain accurate account documentation, and manage the sales process with precision.
Competencies: To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following.
Adaptability - Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles. Measures self against standard of excellence. Recognizes and acts on opportunities. Sets and achieves challenging goals. Takes calculated risks to accomplish goals.
Business Ethics – Inspires the trust of others. Keeps commitments. Treats people with respect. Upholds organizational values. Works with integrity and ethically.
Communications - Exhibits good listening and comprehension. Expresses ideas and thoughts in written form. Expresses ideas and thoughts verbally. Keeps others adequately informed. Selects and uses appropriate communication methods.
Continuous Learning - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses. Pursues training and development opportunities. Seeks feedback to improve performance. Shares expertise with others. Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills.
Problem Solving - Develops alternative solutions. Gathers and analyzes information skillfully. Identifies problems in a timely manner. Resolves problems in early stages. Works well in group problem solving situations.
Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities. Contributes to building a positive team spirit. Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views. Gives and welcomes feedback. Puts success of team above own interests.

3-5+ years of experience in B2B sales with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a consultative selling environment
2+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably selling to SMBs or mid-market accounts
2+ years of direct experience in the payments or fintech industry, with deep knowledge of payment processing, merchant accounts, and fee structures
Proven ability to analyze merchant statements and identify cost-saving opportunities for clients
Experience in solution selling, with demonstrated ability to understand customer needs and position solutions as strategic business tools
Exceptional communication skills and proven ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and sales enablement tools
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in sales, business, or related field

Client Partner - Deliveroo for Work
Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Commercial team sits at the centre of Deliveroo’s marketplace—shaping how we serve restaurants, grocers, and new verticals worldwide.

From negotiating key partnerships to unlocking new revenue streams and crafting data-led growth strategies, we take on big challenges that move the business forward. If you thrive in fast-paced, commercial environments and want to influence the future of a global brand—this is the team for you.
We’re looking for a Client Partner to join our London team. This is a hybrid role. In this role, you’ll help us lead both the acquisition and ongoing management of large, complex global clients, directly shaping how we win, structure, and scale our largest global partnerships.
Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect. https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/the-commercial-team/
What You’ll Be Doing
You’ll be joining the Deliveroo for Work (DfW) team. DfW is Deliveroo’s B2B arm, offering simple and flexible food-spending solutions to corporate clients across global markets, from team lunches to office events and pantry supplies.

s.h: Here’s what your day-to-day might look like
s.t:
Own Enterprise Deals: Lead end-to-end sales cycles for high-value, multi-market partnerships with Fortune 500 and large global organisations.
Manage Strategic Accounts: Oversee account management for top global clients, driving contract renewals, retention, and account expansion with senior stakeholders.
Lead and Develop a Team: Manage, coach, and support a small team, setting clear direction to deliver against global enterprise targets.
Design Bespoke Propositions: Craft tailored commercial models, pricing, and rollout strategies that align Deliveroo's capabilities with complex client needs.
Navigate Technical & Product Complexity: Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Legal teams to solve security/compliance requirements and feed customer insights into the product roadmap.
What You’ll Need to Thrive
Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:
Complex B2B Commercial Experience: Significant track record closing high-value B2B deals and nurturing strategic accounts within complex procurement, legal, and security environments.
People Leadership: Proven ability to manage, coach, and develop a team while balancing hands-on commercial delivery.
Technical & Product Fluency: Ability to engage credibly with Product, Engineering, and Security teams to translate technical constraints into commercial outcomes.
Executive Presence: Exceptional stakeholder management skills with a demonstrated ability to influence C-suite decision-makers across functions.
Strategic & Commercial Judgment: Strong commercial sharpness to structure, negotiate, and execute high-impact global partnerships through long sales cycles.

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:
🔧 Make a visible impact every day Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.
🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.
🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.
We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.
Our Global Structure
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers.

Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications.

We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company.

Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem.

We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries.

We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer.

This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward.

If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage.

You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance.

In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

Success in this role comes from your skills in researching potential customers, strategically engaging them, aligning Toptal ’s value with their needs, and consistently closing new business. This is a full sales cycle role, which means you will be responsible for setting your own meetings through your prospecting and outreach.
This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Prospect, educate, qualify, and close leads and opportunities by engaging dormant accounts and performing lead-generation activities into new targeted accounts. Additionally, manage inbound leads, as required.
Conduct outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn to convey Toptal ’s vision, identify opportunities, present Toptal ’s value proposition, and secure new business.

Learn the breadth of Toptal ’s impact on the world’s largest companies.
Grasp the importance of the outbound function to the success of growing Toptal .
Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.

s.h: In the first month, expect to

Complete our personalized sales training program, complete with mock calls, cold calls, and role-play scenarios.
Learn how to use outreach tools (SalesLoft, Zoominfo, SalesNavigator).

Learn how to analyze industry drivers, business problems, and target buyers.

s.h: In the first three months, expect to

While exercising discretion and independent judgment, uncover new opportunities with existing accounts and target accounts that result in revenue-generating engagements for Toptal .
Hit call/email quotas and fully ramped objectives.
Become proficient in using our SaaS tools.
Learn how to maintain excellent data integrity in Salesforce.com.

Mission - Why we exist, what we do, and why we need you
Onomi is the HCP engagement and intelligence platform for life sciences. Pharma commercial and medical teams use Onomi to run their HCP engagements, congresses, webinars, advisory boards, and everyday meetings, and to capture what actually happens in them: every interaction captured with consent, matched to the right HCP record, and written back to Veeva or Salesforce in minutes, so the engagement they already pay for comes back as data their teams can act on.

This is Onomi's first dedicated business development role in the US, and you are not starting from zero.

We have a strong US account management and event services team on the ground, a US customer base of 100 referenceable pharma companies including AstraZeneca, Takeda, Sanofi, GSK, and BeOne, and over 500,000 HCPs engaged across our platform every month.

Our go-to-market is event-first: our leadership team speaks at the industry's events, usually with a booth alongside, and you will be there with them; at key conventions we prospect as participants, where our customers gather; our biweekly webinars hand you a warm, named audience after every session.

What has been missing are the people on the ground converting that presence and proof into new logos. We are hiring 3 talents at once as our founding US new-business group, working directly with the CEO, the leadership team, and senior sales colleagues in other regions.

[35%] Work industry events: build target lists from attendee data before each event, staff the booth at leadership's speaking events, prospect conventions as a participant (first alongside colleagues, then solo), and follow up with every named contact with relevant messaging.
[20%] Run personalized outbound to webinar audiences and industry event attendee lists, turning warm names into booked first meetings. No mass sequences; every message is yours and very specific.
[20%] Run first meetings: your three-slide story, sharp discovery questions, and a crisp follow-up that gets forwarded internally.
[25%] Progress opportunities with senior support: bring in a senior seller, our solutions team or our leadership team at the right moment, keep every deal moving in an open deal channel, and co-sell through scoping and close.

s.h: In your first month, you will
s.t:
Join our leadership team at live industry events: staff the booth at tradeshows and walk congresses with them.
Master our core sales plays: rehearse them, listen to past winning calls, and run mock first meetings that convince the team you can do it alone.
Start outbound on your first event attendee list and webinar audience, and book your first attended meetings.

s.h: In your first 3 months, you will
s.t:
Have 30+ attended first meetings on the board, with a 70%-plus show rate.
Staff your first medical convention solo, with a pre-event target list, a floor contact log, and 100% follow-up.
Convert each webinar cycle into at least 2 attended meetings.
Have your first opportunities in discovery with a senior co-seller attached.
By month 6, you will have closed your first new US logo, co-sold with a senior colleague (for which you will get 100% quota retirement), and earned a clear conversation about your lane: toward closing bigger deals or leading meeting generation as we scale the team.

s.h: What you need to be great at
s.t:
Speed and consistency despite ambiguity: following up same day, never dropping a ball, staying creative when the playbook runs out.
Curiosity about the product and the customer: you ask why a customer runs things the way they do, you go into the layers underneath.
Nobody expects you to become a sales engineer, but if your answer to every product question is 'let me loop someone in,' buyers lose interest and the someone loses patience.
In-person presence: you are at your best on a floor, at a booth, in a hallway conversation, and you want to travel to make that happen (expect to hop on a plane every 2-3 weeks).
Taking feedback fast: we coach constantly; what we correct on Monday shows up in your work on Tuesday.
Working with support rather than an army: you handle what you can and escalate deliberately.
Writing that sells: short, specific, personal messages that get replies.

s.h: What we are most curious about
s.t:
Tell us about events or trade shows you have worked on: what you did before, on, and after the floor, and what it produced, with real numbers.
Walk us through a product you sold and what sat underneath it: how it worked, why customers chose it, what its limits were.
What are 2 or 3 outreach tactics that reliably got you replies and meetings, and how did you know they worked?
Tell us about the last piece of feedback that changed how you work, and what changed.
Compensation: 150,000 to 190,000 USD on-target earnings (60% base, 40% variable), with guaranteed variable during ramp.
US-based, remote, near a major hub airport.
